source_caption:
The Wind Rises is inspired by the life of real Japanese aeronautical engineer Jiro Horikoshi, the designer of the Mitsubishi A6M Zero fighter aircraft used by Japan during World War II. Rather than presenting a strict biography, the film blends historical fact with fiction and dreamlike imagination.

The character Naoko is fictional, but her story draws inspiration from the novel The Wind Has Risen by Tatsuo Hori, a semi-autobiographical work about a young couple facing illness. Set in a time before effective treatments for tuberculosis existed, the anime imagines a fragile romance shaped by limited time, echoing the quiet tragedy found in Hori’s writing.

In the film, Miyazaki also adds recurring dream sequences in which Jiro meets the Italian aircraft designer Giovanni Battista Caproni. These scenes reflect the protagonist’s passion for aviation and the tension between creating beautiful machines and the reality that they may be used for war.

Directed by Hayao Miyazaki for Studio Ghibli, the anime mixes historical events—such as the Great Kantō Earthquake of 1923 and Japan’s rapid pre-war industrialization—with a deeply personal story about dreams, love, and responsibility. After the film’s release in 2013, Miyazaki announced his retirement, though he later returned to filmmaking to direct The Boy and the Heron (2023).

source_details.synopsis: The Wind Rises (Japanese: 風立ちぬ, Hepburn: Kaze Tachinu; lit. 'The Wind Has Risen') is a 2013 Japanese animated historical drama film written and directed by Hayao Miyazaki based on his 2009 manga of the same name. Produced by Studio Ghibli and distributed by Toho, the film stars the voices of Hideaki Anno, Miori Takimoto, Hidetoshi Nishijima, Masahiko Nishimura, Morio Kazama, Keiko Takeshita, Mirai Shida, Jun Kunimura, Shinobu Otake, and Nomura Mansai. The film portrays a fictionalised account of the life of Japanese aeronautical engineer Jiro Horikoshi, in particular his engineering career from his time at the University of Tokyo in 1923 to the first test flight of the Mitsubishi Ka-14 on 4
